_why: M5 deep-dive end state, read before its Teardown. SIMULATED, as the lab. State-tolerant: each entry reads only the objects the deep dive itself creates in m5-core-gang and m5-claims, so it holds whether or not the lab's objects still exist. Object state only (STANDARDS.md C26): a core scheduling.k8s.io PodGroup's minCount against the count of its members with .spec.nodeName, the PodGroup's own condition, and a Kueue Workload condition reason read through workloads.kueue.x-k8s.io. Every kubectl runs with KUBECONFIG exported and --context kind-grid-core; every matches is anchored. Run from the learner tree root; in src: (cd labs && node ../scripts/run-checks.mjs m5/deep-dive.checks.json).

checks.describe: topic 1: the core scheduling.k8s.io PodGroup research-gang asks for minCount 4, and four of its Deployment's Pods carry .spec.nodeName — the gang was placed whole
checks.run: export KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}"; m=$(kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m5-core-gang get podgroups.scheduling.k8s.io research-gang -o jsonpath='{.spec.schedulingPolicy.gang.minCount}' 2>/dev/null); b=$(kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m5-core-gang get pods -l app=research-gang -o json | jq '[.items[] | select(.spec.nodeName != null)] | length'); echo "mincount=${m:-none} bound=$b"

checks.describe: topic 2: oversized-gang's ten Pods exist, none carries .spec.nodeName, and its core scheduling.k8s.io PodGroup's scheduled condition is False — a gang that cannot be placed whole is not placed in part
checks.run: export KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}"; p=$(kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m5-core-gang get pods -l app=oversized-gang -o json | jq -r '"pods=" + (.items | length | tostring) + " bound=" + ([.items[] | select(.spec.nodeName != null)] | length | tostring)'); s=$(kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m5-core-gang get podgroups.scheduling.k8s.io oversized-gang -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '[.status.conditions[]? | select(.type | test("Scheduled")) | .status] | first // "none"'); echo "$p scheduled=${s:-none}"

checks.describe: topic 4: precreated-claim's Kueue Workload in m5-claims, whose Pod names a claim created ahead of time through resourceClaimName, has QuotaReserved reason Misconfigured — refused at this release, a documented limitation and not a way around quota
checks.run: KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m5-claims get workloads.kueue.x-k8s.io -o json | jq -r '[.items[] | select(any(.metadata.ownerReferences[]?; .kind == "Job" and .name == "precreated-claim"))] | first | if . == null then "qr=absent" else "qr=" + ([.status.conditions[]? | select(.type == "QuotaReserved") | .reason] | first // "none") end'
